title: cat.allocation

node_id.description: A comma-separated list of node identifiers or names used to limit the returned information.

h.description: A comma-separated list of columns names to display. It supports simple wildcards.

s.description:
List of columns that determine how the table should be sorted.
Sorting defaults to ascending and can be changed by setting `:asc`
or `:desc` as a suffix to the column name.

local.description:
If `true`, the request computes the list of selected nodes from the
local cluster state. If `false` the list of selected nodes are computed
from the cluster state of the master node. In both cases the coordinating
node will send requests for further information to each selected node.

master_timeout.description: Period to wait for a connection to the master node.

description:
Get shard allocation information.

Get a snapshot of the number of shards allocated to each data node and their disk space.

IMPORTANT: CAT APIs are only intended for human consumption using the command line or Kibana console. They are not intended for use by applications.
